name: Shortcode Basic Tags
description: Provides basic shortcode tags like highlight, dropcap, etc.
project_description: Shortcode Basic Tags is the bundled starter tag set for the Shortcode framework. It registers ready-to-use shortcode plugins in src/Plugin/Shortcode/: quote, img, highlight, button, dropcap, item, clear, link, block, and random. Most render through Twig templates registered by a hook_theme() implementation (shortcode_quote/img/button/dropcap/item/clear/link); highlight and random build their output directly. The img/link/button tags use the parent module's MediaUrlResolver to resolve media entities and image styles. Each tag can be enabled, disabled, and reordered per text format on the Shortcodes filter settings. Requires the shortcode base module; core_version_requirement ^11.1 || ^12.
